# v0.7.0 — ROADMAP v0.7 semver release

> **Status:** Shipped 2026-06-13 — tag [v0.7.0](https://github.com/eddiethedean/ontologos/releases/tag/v0.7.0)

## Highlights

- **Semver alignment:** crate version **0.7.0** matches ROADMAP v0.7 (dependency-first adapters)
- **`ontologos-bridge`:** core ↔ horned-owl/oxrdf/reasonable adapters
- **RL/RDFS → reasonable**; **EL → in-house** completion in `ontologos-el`
- Bugfix pass: EL validation/domains, CLI clashes, merge limits, parser panic guard, conformance honesty
- No public API changes from **0.6.1**

## Published artifacts

- **crates.io:** `ontologos-core`, `ontologos-profile`, `ontologos-parser`, `ontologos-bridge`, `ontologos-rdfs`, `ontologos-rl`, `ontologos-el`, `ontologos-query`, `ontologos-explain` at **0.7.0**
- **PyPI:** `ontologos` **0.7.0**

## Upgrade notes

Bump all `ontologos-*` crates together:

```toml
ontologos-core = "0.7.0"
ontologos-bridge = "0.7.0"
ontologos-parser = "0.7.0"
ontologos-profile = "0.7.0"
ontologos-rdfs = "0.7.0"
ontologos-rl = "0.7.0"
ontologos-el = "0.7.0"
ontologos-query = "0.7.0"
ontologos-explain = "0.7.0"
```

Python: `pip install ontologos==0.7.0`

See [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md) and [docs/migration/v0.6.x-to-v0.7.0.md](../../docs/migration/v0.6.x-to-v0.7.0.md).
